lines.t: Beloved ones, I've spoken a multitude of words
And your hearing I have given in a shout and poured out my spirit
Behold, I have whispered into the ears of this generation
Of every man, woman, and child
Yet who gave heed? Who stood up and proclaimed
claim my coming, who among men stood firm for who I truly am, who bowed down and gave
me glory, who among this great multitude fell on their faces in true repentance, who among
those who say they are my people sought to make their repentance full.
The little children gave heed The hearts of the little ones skipped a beat
They, alone, embraced my voice for they remember And seek to return to the place from whence
they came Yet this foolish and most wicked generation
Despised me in their zeal And refused to give heed
Plugging their ears when I called Turning their backs when I drew near
Thus I removed my spirit from the people and drew back
My hand from the multitude and they were forsaken That they might stumble, that they might fall
That they might reap all they have sown in their arrogance
Suffocating on account of their greed
Until they drown in the depths of their vanity
To their own shame
For I tell you the truth
That which is tipped cannot be set upright again
And that which has been set in motion
Can not be stopped, lo, even that which was held Captive in the depths of silence has been released
Behold, it comes forth, increasing by order of magnitude And can in no wise be put back again
Says the Lord
The open, when I lie
Oh, no
